A considerable collection of Formula 1 and motorsport stickers, 1970s-1980s,
a wide and varied collection of assorted stickers relating to mainly Formula 1 and other motorsport race teams, drivers, circuits, and sponsors, personally obtained by the vendor at Grand Prix and motorsports events, majority displayed in three large format photograph albums with transparent overlays, some stuck-in and some with backing film, and including:

And together with assorted un-mounted loose stickers for various Formula 1 subjects. Inspection advised.
